description: ITHIM is a software platform listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Platforms and Software Resources > Transportation Planning Tools and Platforms", published or maintained by as named on mrc-epid.cam.ac.uk. Integrated Transport and Health Impact Model (ITHIM) refers to a range of related models and tools developed to perform integrated assessment of the health effects of transport scenarios and policies at the urban and national level. This page points to different literature, R code, and US specific resources. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Platforms and Software Resources > Transportation Planning Tools and Platforms". The entry links to mrc-epid.cam.ac.uk. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. The entry links to a product or project page, not a repository, so open-source status was not confirmed and is recorded as false. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-apa-urban-regional-planning-resources-list.
